sentences.en: Their communication may be much more complex than we thought.
sentences.zh: 他们的交流可能比我们想象的要复杂得多。

sentences.en: For a moment there, I thought he had gone mad.
sentences.zh: 有一瞬间，我觉得他疯了。

sentences.en: I look forward to hearing your thoughts on this matter.
sentences.zh: 我期待听到你对这个问题的看法。
